attribute_information./id: Unique URI of this verifiable credential.
attribute_information./name: Display name of the credential type.
attribute_information./validFrom: Date and time from which the credential is valid.
attribute_information./issuer/id: Decentralized identifier (DID) of the issuing authority.
attribute_information./issuer/name: Name of the credential issuer (Chief Permitting Officer).
attribute_information./credentialSubject/id: Canonical URI of the Mines Act permit in the BC permit register.
attribute_information./credentialSubject/name: Human-readable title combining permit number and holder or site name.
attribute_information./credentialSubject/description: Narrative summary of the permit, holder, and assessed facilities.
attribute_information./credentialSubject/assessorLevel: UNTP assessor level for this attestation.
attribute_information./credentialSubject/assessmentLevel: UNTP assessment level (authority-mandate for Mines Act permits).
attribute_information./credentialSubject/issuedToParty/id: URI of the legal entity holding the permit.
attribute_information./credentialSubject/issuedToParty/name: Legal name of the permit holder.
attribute_information./credentialSubject/issuedToParty/registe: Business or entity registration identifier in the BC Registry.
attribute_information./credentialSubject/issuedToParty/idSchem: URI of the identifier scheme for the permit holder.
Name of the identifier scheme (BC Registry).
attribute_information./credentialSubject/referenceScheme/id: URI of the statutory conformity scheme (Mines Act).
attribute_information./credentialSubject/referenceScheme/name: Name of the legal framework (Mines Act, British Columbia).
attribute_information./credentialSubject/referenceProfile/id: URI of the BC Mines Act permit governance profile.
attribute_information./credentialSubject/referenceProfile/name: Name of the governance profile applied to this credential.
attribute_information./credentialSubject/conformityAssessment/: URI identifying this conformity assessment (same as permit URI).

attribute_information./id: URI unique de ce justificatif vérifiable.

attribute_information./issuer/name: Nom de l'émetteur du justificatif (dirigeant principal des permis).
attribute_information./credentialSubject/id: URI canonique du permis en vertu de la Loi sur les mines dans le registre des permis de la C.-B.
attribute_information./credentialSubject/name: Titre lisible combinant le numéro de permis et le nom du titulaire ou du site.
attribute_information./credentialSubject/description: Résumé narratif du permis, du titulaire et des installations évaluées.
attribute_information./credentialSubject/assessorLevel: Niveau d'évaluateur UNTP pour cette attestation.
attribute_information./credentialSubject/assessmentLevel: Niveau d'évaluation UNTP (mandat de l'autorité pour les permis en vertu de la Loi sur les mines).
attribute_information./credentialSubject/issuedToParty/id: URI de l'entité juridique titulaire du permis.
attribute_information./credentialSubject/issuedToParty/name: Nom juridique du titulaire du permis.
attribute_information./credentialSubject/issuedToParty/registe: Identifiant d'enregistrement de l'entreprise ou de l'entité au registre de la C.-B.
attribute_information./credentialSubject/issuedToParty/idSchem: URI du schéma d'identification du titulaire du permis.
Nom du schéma d'identification (registre de la C.-B.).
attribute_information./credentialSubject/referenceScheme/id: URI du schéma de conformité législatif (Loi sur les mines).
attribute_information./credentialSubject/referenceScheme/name: Nom du cadre juridique (Loi sur les mines, Colombie-Britannique).
attribute_information./credentialSubject/referenceProfile/id: URI du profil de gouvernance des permis en vertu de la Loi sur les mines de la C.-B.
attribute_information./credentialSubject/referenceProfile/name: Nom du profil de gouvernance appliqué à ce justificatif.
